response.query: Provide studies relevant to: Why the quantification of modularity effects remains an issue for modular product families, topics discussed:
response.answer: Quantification of modularity effects in modular product families remains challenging due to complex interactions and varying design configurations. Lack of standardized metrics complicates precise measurement. Research focuses on improving these metrics for better understanding and optimization.
